statement: An MTS EM sector descends to Maxwell only if the observed electromagnetic readout is a q_obs-owned 1-form A_mu with field strength F=dA and gauge redundancy A -> A+dlambda.
derivation_or_meaning: Gauge redundancy prevents an extra longitudinal charge from becoming a hidden source mass or WEP channel.

statement: The low-energy action must reduce to S_EM=-(1/4) int sqrt(-g_eff) Z_EM F_ab F^ab plus terms that are topological, higher-order, compactly supported, or explicitly bounded.
derivation_or_meaning: This is the unique local two-derivative gauge-invariant Maxwell stress route in the same observed metric/coframe.

statement: If MHD3778_1 holds, variation with respect to g_eff gives T_EM^{ab}=Z_EM(F^{a c}F^b_c - (1/4)g_eff^{ab}F_cd F^cd), and this is the EM piece of T_total.
derivation_or_meaning: This imports the 3760 standard identity but ties it to MTS descent and Pi_M_total.

statement: Z_EM and charge/current normalization must be q_obs-owned or superselected, not species-, material-, frame-, or environment-labelled.
derivation_or_meaning: Otherwise EM binding and material response produce WEP, clock, PPN, and source-normalization residuals.

statement: Massive Proca terms, disformal EM metrics, birefringent light cones, nonminimal RF^2 couplings, axion-like F wedge F readout effects, or hidden carrier stress must vanish or be bounded.
derivation_or_meaning: Any such term is not ordinary Maxwell Hilbert stress and must remain an explicit residual owner.

statement: With one descended matter+EM action, nabla_a T_EM^{ab}=-F^b_c J^c cancels the matter Lorentz force inside nabla_a T_total^{ab}; only parent exchange or non-Hilbert owner currents remain.
derivation_or_meaning: This is the EM reason same-source descent can look GR-like locally.

statement: Even if Maxwell descent holds, EM field energy outside a chosen material radius contributes to M_H,total unless the source domain includes it or a tail/flux bound is supplied.
derivation_or_meaning: Maxwell descent fixes the stress tensor; it does not automatically make finite source domains safe.

statement: If MHD3778_0 through MHD3778_6 hold, EM/Poynting contributes only as ordinary total Hilbert stress in Pi_M_total, and EM-owned mu_extra rows close except declared finite tail/flux bounds.
derivation_or_meaning: This is a local-GR-compatible EM source theorem, still conditional on parent signatures.
